using std::cout;
using std::string;

    string s;
    cin >> s;

    char first = s[0];
    s = s.substr(1, s.size() - 1);

    size_t pos = s.find("at");
    if (pos != string::npos)
        s.replace(pos, 2, "@");

    size_t dotPos;

    cout << first << s;
    return 0;

#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main()
{
    string input;
    cin >> input;

    string result;
    result += input[0];
    input = input.substr(1);

    size_t atPos = input.find("at");
    if (atPos != string::npos)
        input.replace(atPos, 2, "@");

    for (size_t i = 0; i < input.size(); ++i)
    {
        size_t dotPos = input.find("dot", i);
        if (dotPos == string::npos) break;
        if (dotPos == input.size() - 3) break;
        input.replace(dotPos, 3, ".");
        i = dotPos; // continue from after replacement
    }

    result += input;
    cout << result;
    return 0;
}
